items.title: The image of the colimit of the local cohomologies along the principal opens through a prime is the set of elements dying at that prime
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement describes the image of the canonical map from the filtered colimit of the local cohomologies of the ideals generated by the ideal together with an element outside a prime, in three parts: the image is the kernel of the localisation at the prime, the map is injective when one degree lower vanishes after localisation, and it is an isomorphism when both degrees vanish (author lemma at source lines 451-470, label lemma-elements-come-from-bigger). The proof (source lines 472-483) gets a short exact sequence at each degree from the degeneration of the local cohomology spectral sequence of the chapter on dualizing complexes, reads off the image, and completes the injectivity statement with the vanishing of the colimit for the multiplicative set of elements outside the prime, whose statement is reproduced as a context span (proof lines 473-481). The degeneration and the identification of the image are the content. H2.
